corrections.what: Made both rings true circles with one radius, 49.64 px
corrections.why: DR-03. Circle fits to the ring centrelines give 49.53 and 49.76 px; the left ring's raster is about 1 px wider than tall. The catalogue calls for two equal circles.

corrections.what: Put both centres on one baseline, y 60.69
corrections.why: DR-03 and the catalogue ('their centres share a baseline'). Fitted centres sit at y 60.88 and 60.49.

corrections.what: Drew the rings at the set line weight W, 5.5 px
corrections.why: DR-03 one line weight. This icon's own strokes measure 5.77 px, 5 percent heavier.

corrections.what: Review fix: ended the four black outer-arc ends with square (butt) caps 2.75 px (3.17 deg of arc) past each crossing, instead of round caps at the crossings
corrections.why: The red sheet finishes the black in a sharp V pointing into the lens at both crossings; the round caps pushed a soft blob 2.75 px into the red and blunted the lens points.

source_notes: Centres kept at the fitted x positions (60.86 and 132.64), so the overlap width matches the sheet. Layering follows the red sheet: black outer arcs over both crossings. At each crossing the two black arcs overrun the crossing by half a line weight and end square over the red, which gives the V.
